name: Dustwallow Marsh
summary: Across central Kalimdor, Dustwallow Marsh lies between the Barrens and the Great Sea. Underground springs feed its treacherous fens, where dangerous predators, covert faction skirmishes, and the black dragonflight all lurk. To the east, theramore isle is an Alliance fortress; to the northwest, Horde-allied Stonemaul ogres hold Brackenwall Village.

sections.title: A Drowned Landscape
sections.body:
Before the Great Sundering, Dustwallow was a high, grassy plain where herds roamed. The cataclysm shattered the valley and raised the water table, drowning the land in endless stagnant pools, mossy shallows, and choking mud.

Underground springs keep the marsh humid and submerged beneath thick fog. Crocolisks, raptors, and spiders haunt the fens. Crumbling causeways cross them, but jagged shallows and wandering bogs make every step beyond those roads perilous.

sections.title: Old Hatreds and Uneasy Truces
sections.body:
Dustwallow stayed largely wild until after the Third War, when Lady Jaina Proudmoore led human refugees across the sea and founded the citadel of Theramore Isle on the eastern coast. Soon, Kul Tiran forces under Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore fought Thrall's fledgling Horde in bloody battles across the wetlands. The Admiral was defeated, and Theramore and Orgrimmar now keep an official armistice.

Tension still smolders. Theramore faces desertions and sabotage, while spies wage quiet, deadly conflicts across the fens.

sections.title: The Shadow of the Wyrmbog
sections.body:
In southern Dustwallow, rocky ground rises into the Dragonmurk and Wyrmbog. The Stonemaul ogres first settled there under Rexxar, their half-ogre champion, until the black dragonflight drove them violently from Stonemaul Village. The displaced ogres fled north to Brackenwall Village under Overlord Mok'Morokk and swore vengeance.

Onyxia, daughter of Deathwing, lurks among the jagged crags. She directs her brood and weaves sinister machinations far beyond the swamp.

faq.q: What is the main Alliance settlement here?
faq.answer: The Alliance's main settlement is Theramore Isle, a fortified city-state on a rocky island off the eastern coast. Lady Jaina Proudmoore founded it after the Third War. A narrow roadway links it to Kalimdor, and vital ship routes run to Menethil Harbor in the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Where can Horde adventurers find refuge in the swamp?
faq.answer: Horde travelers find refuge at Brackenwall Village in the marsh's northwest. The Stonemaul ogres founded the settlement, joined the Horde under Rexxar, and opened their gates to orcish and tauren allies.

faq.q: Why are there so many black dragons in the southern marsh?
faq.answer: Black dragons gather in the southern marsh because the Wyrmbog and Dragonmurk are Onyxia's domain and brood grounds. Her black dragonspawn drove out the Stonemaul ogres and made nests for whelps and drakes among the rocky outcroppings and deep caves.

faq.q: What happened to the Stonemaul ogres' original home?
faq.answer: The Stonemaul ogres once lived peacefully in Stonemaul Village in the southern marsh. The black dragonflight attacked, slaughtering many and forcing the survivors to flee northwest to Brackenwall Village.

faq.q: Who lives in the lonely cottage out in the Quagmire?
aliases: who is the witch in the swamp
faq.answer: Tabetha owns the cottage and lives quietly as an eccentric, powerful hermit mage in the marsh's depths. Arcane practitioners seek her instruction or help cleansing volatile magical relics.

faq.q: What is Alcaz Island and who controls it?
faq.answer: Strashaz naga control Alcaz Island, a heavily guarded isle off the marsh's northeast coast. Dangerous elite defenders patrol it, and hydras lurk in the surrounding waters.

angles.text: Theramore Isle is the heart of the Alliance's presence on Kalimdor. Arriving via menethil harbor, you guard its causeways while untangling a web of deserters and missing envoys.
Horde emissaries come to support the beleaguered Stonemaul ogres at Brackenwall Village. You help repel dragon incursions from the Wyrmbog and keep a wary eye on human movements along the coast.
As a mage, you may cross the fens to Tabetha's Farm in the Quagmire. The recluse offers unique expertise on arcane conduits and ancient power sources.
